'''Jhamara''' is a historical battle location. 

A battle of the [[Children of the Light]] against [[Murandy]] and [[Altara]]. Because of a tickling in the back of his head, [[Pedron Niall|Niall]] set a third of his army to watch mountains said to be impassable; an [[Illianer]] army that was supposed to be a hundred miles away came out of those impassable passes.[[Category:Battles]]
